| Idle | Hidden | none |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DeepSeek-style dark card (`#1E2235` / `#4D6BFE`).
- Always-on-top frameless window, bottom-right, "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"visible over any application.
- Auto-collapses into a 25 px slim right-edge tab after 5 s while the "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"AI is thinking, so it stays visible without blocking desktop controls.
- Hover or click the edge tab"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" to expand it manually; new turns, questions, permission requests, and completions expand it automat"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ically.
- Click the **X** button to dismiss the current popup; the next new turn, question, permissi"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"on request, or completion will show it again.
- Questions are shown with their options, which is eno"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ugh to know what is being decided; the answer itself is still given in the DSH Web UI (the popup is "},{"id":"p8s8","text":"read-only by design).
- Multiple sessions are summarized automatically.
- The popup process stays al"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ive while DSH runs; it exits ~15 s after the status endpoint becomes unreachable.
- No browser exten"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"sion required; the popup is a native desktop window."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Status JSON"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`GET http://127.0.0.1:7389/status` returns:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`mode` priority: `pending` (an approval is waiting) > `question` (a question is waiting) > `running`"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" > `done` (shown for 12 s) > `idle`.
`pendingKind` is `approval` or `question`. `timeText` is the th"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"inking timer while `running` and the waiting time while `question`; `detailText` carries the first q"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" `running` and the waiting time while `question`; `detailText` carries the first question's options."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### From a local checkout"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### From npm (once published)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Environment variable | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `DSH_THINKING_NOTIFIER_PORT` | `7389` | Local status server port. | `DSH_THINKING_NOTIFIER_NO_POPUP` | unset | Set to `1` to run the status server without lau"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"nching the desktop popup (headless, tests). |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness Web UI (`dsh web`)
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`

- macOS/Linux: Python 3 with `tkinter`"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Verification status"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Being explicit about what has actually been tested, so nobody is surprised:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Area | Status |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Thinking / done states, popup geometry, sounds, single instance | verified on Windows 10/11 (Power"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"Shell 5.1 + WPF) |
| Question state (`ask_user_question`) | verified end to end in a live DSH sessio"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"n (a real question drove the popup into the waiting state, and it cleared when the answer arrived), "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"against the real `ctx.userQuestions` service in a cordis context, and by the smoke test |
| Permissi"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"on alert (amber) | **verified only with the mock status service.** On a Windows DSH install without "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"a confining sandbox, an out-of-workspace write is not intercepted, so no approval is raised by the r"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"untime; the request only appears when a tool call explicitly asks for a `sandbox_permissions` escala"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"tion or a pre-execute hook returns `ask` |

- `~/.dsh/tn-popup-debug.log` — popup"},{"id":"p38s3","text":" script lifecycle and polling errors."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"If the popup does not appear after restarting `dsh web`, check those logs first.
